name: Template Derived Value Spell
displayText: Target friendly Unit gains Health equal to its ATK for that combat.

text.flavor: A `stat` value reads a number off a card instead of printing one. `of: "effect_target"` is the "its" in "equal to its ATK": the card this instruction acts on, read per recipient, from the derived statline as it resolves. Use `"source"` or `"trigger_subject"` when "it" is another card.
